name: Hotelbeds API
tagline: B2B hotel bedbank booking and content APIs for accommodations worldwide
description: Hotelbeds provides B2B hotel APIs for searching availability, booking accommodations, and retrieving hotel content (descriptions, images, facilities). Developers integrate with Hotel and Content APIs using API-Key and X-Signature authentication to power travel platforms, OTAs, and booking engines with live inventory from a major global bedbank.

auth.details: API-Key header plus X-Signature (SHA-256 of apiKey + secret + timestamp); self-serve developer portal signup

use_cases: search hotel availability by destination and dates
book a hotel room with guest details
get hotel content descriptions and images
check booking status or cancel a reservation
list hotels in a destination for content catalog
